items.title: Critical Vulnerability Exposes Industrial Robot Fleets to Hacking
items.description: The vulnerability, CVE-2026-8153, affects Universal Robots PolyScope 5 and it can be exploited for OS command injection. The post Critical Vulnerability Exposes Industrial Robot Fleets to Hacking appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: GitHub Actions Supply Chain Attack Redirects Tags to Steal CI/CD Credentials
items.description: In yet another software supply chain attack, threat actors have compromised the popular GitHub Actions workflow, actions-cool/issues-helper, to run malicious code that harvests sensitive credentials and exfiltrates them to an attacker-controlled server. items.title: Mythos Preview Builds PoC Exploits in Automated Vulnerability Research
items.description: Anthropic’s Mythos Preview security-focused AI model is crossing a critical threshold in automated vulnerability research, not just finding bugs, but chaining them together into working proof-of-concept exploits. That’s the finding from Cloudflare’s security team, which spent several weeks running the model against more than fifty internal repositories as part of Anthropic’s invite-only Project…
